title: Unequal-Width 4-Corner Mixture (4.3x Scale Spread) (Published Prior Cohort)
intuition: Published-prior cohort variant of `vector_unequal_width` with explicit `learnable=True` MoG prior declaration, testing transfer consistency across minor prior-contract differences. Four equal-mass corner Gaussians with distinct widths sigma in {0.07, 0.12, 0.20, 0.30}. Probes Law 3A (W1 ray-length identifiability): the trainer must match each cluster's individual width without smearing narrow clusters or shrinking broad ones.
failure_mode: Unit-slope W1/Lipschitz critics exert width-independent pull, collapsing wide clusters or letting stray samples contaminate the narrowest sigma=0.07 mode.
protocol_notes: Separate published transfer cohort of `vector_unequal_width`; historical sensitivity observed across architectures.
